text: The compiler shall prevent concurrent build processes from corrupting the shared incremental compilation cache by applying each update atomically and rejecting cache entries whose content hash is inconsistent.
The compiler's hosted build service must require every developer to present a valid account credential before it accepts a source file for compilation.
The database server shall execute a replication instruction from a peer node only if the accompanying message authentication code verifies against the per-connection session key.
The online banking application must allow the bank to freeze a customer profile showing signs of takeover and must deny every operation attempted on a frozen profile.
The database server must provide column-level cryptographic transformation of stored values so that a person with raw access to the data files cannot read the contents of designated fields.
The data warehousing system shall encrypt the datasets of each loaded data source while they are being ingested and, where configured, while they are queried afterwards.
The hospital patient-record system shall refuse entry of a blood-pressure reading outside the physiologically possible range and shall require the clinician to correct the value.
The smart-home IoT controller shall close the administrative interface session after ten minutes without interaction and shall require a new session to be started before further changes.
The simulation software shall allow only users holding the lead-engineer role to view and to edit the parameters of a scenario, and shall refuse both operations for every other user.
The screen capture tool must compute a digest of every saved recording and compare it on opening, flagging the file as altered whenever the digests differ.
The smart-card electronic purse terminal software shall close the card session and clear any transaction authorisation as soon as the terminal application exits.
The compiler's web-based IDE shall terminate a session after 15 minutes without user input so that an unattended workstation cannot be exploited by an intruder.
The online banking application must present a challenge that only a human can solve after a series of consecutive failed login attempts, in order to block automated guessing attacks.

The hospital patient-record system must ensure that the integrity marking in medical images survives resizing and compression, and survives deliberate attempts to remove it, so alterations remain detectable.
The screen capture tool shall require users to prove their identity with their assigned account name and secret before opening its management console.
The compiler shall expose its plugin interface in a way that prevents third-party plugins from disabling or tampering with the compiler's code-signing and sandbox checks.
The smart-home controller must compare an MD5 digest of the downloaded configuration backup with the published digest, and shall refuse to restore a backup whose digests differ.
When a technician runs remote diagnostics on the smart-home IoT controller, the controller shall hide residents' presence history and voice recordings from the diagnostic output.

The screen capture tool shall require the user to complete a human-verification challenge before accepting further activation-key entries once repeated invalid entries are detected, thereby blocking scripted brute-force attempts.

The online banking application shall detect automated credential-stuffing traffic, block the offending source addresses, and send an alert to the security administrator each time such traffic is detected.

If a controller's identity check or privilege check fails, the air traffic control software shall refuse the session and shall execute the response defined by the operating authority, which may include alerting the legitimate controller about reused login tokens.
The online banking application shall require customers to renew their login credentials at least once every quarter and shall refuse to authenticate a customer whose renewal is overdue.
The screen capture tool shall let a new user register an account and shall authenticate that user on later launches by matching a scanned fingerprint to the enrolled template.
The screen capture tool must rely on the enterprise single sign-on provider to confirm who a user is before it unlocks any of its recording features.
The simulation software must verify the consistency of input parameter files before a run begins and shall refuse files that were deliberately crafted to corrupt the model state.
The air traffic control software shall reject flight plan entries in which altitude, speed or coordinate fields contain values outside their defined types and ranges.
The compiler shall check each imported library for an embedded origin mark and report to the developer whether the mark proves the declared publisher.
The hospital patient-record system shall reject any update that would leave a patient's medication, allergy and diagnosis entries mutually inconsistent.
The simulation software must keep the cryptographic keys of each tenant organisation in isolated key stores so that no tenant can read the model data of another tenant.

The electronic purse card must prove its genuineness to a payment terminal by answering a cryptographic challenge that the terminal checks against the issuer's registered card key before any debit is performed.
The online banking application shall block any client session that submits more than ten malformed requests within one minute while continuing to serve all other sessions normally.
The air traffic control software shall encrypt flight plans exchanged with ground stations and shall block and report any attempt to intercept or replay messages on those links.
The compiler shall encrypt proprietary source modules while they are being imported into a build workspace so that unauthorised parties cannot read them.
The simulation software shall compute a keyed checksum over the number of runs and the aggregate result values in each exported result set, so that later tampering with those figures is detectable.
The sales forecasting system shall prevent unauthorised readers from viewing confidential revenue figures that it passes from the data collector to the model engine.
The simulation software shall allow only users with the modify permission to start a change request on a baseline model.

The smart-home controller shall confirm the identity of a person using its configuration console by comparing typing rhythm together with pointer movement patterns against the enrolled profile of that person.
The sales forecasting system shall reject any analyst login secret whose entropy is lower than 64 bits at the time it is set.
The data warehousing system shall encrypt customer records moving from the extraction service to the load service so that no unauthorised party can read them while in transit.
